newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey reaffirms 96/97 sugar output at 1.85 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Turkey reaffirms 96/97 sugar output at 1.85 mln T.

text.p: Turkey's state sugar refineries head Selahattin Hun on Friday reaffirmed earlier estimates that Turkey would produce 1.85 million tonnes of sugar in 1996/97, up from 1.5 million tonnes in the previous year, Anatolian news agency said.
"All of our sugar needs will be met from 1.85 million tonnes of production this year," the agency quoted Hun, general manager of Turkseker, as saying..
Turkey consumed about 1.8 million tonnes of sugar last year.
Hun said Turkseker, which operates 25 refineries, would produce 1.5 million tonnes and three private refineries 350,000 tonnes this season.
He said beet purchases from farmers were continuing and all sugar refineries in Turkey would have begun production by October 4.

He earlier said the rise in sugar output was due to a 40 percent increase in area sown to beet in 1996/97 which stood at 421,300 hectares. He had said Turkey would not need to import sugar in the calendar 1997.
